passages.context: Ambrose's statement that Peter could not have doubted and that John believed on seeing the tomb empty of the body, read in the retrieved file under its lemma on Luke 24:37 and 45, with sections 178 and 180 in view. Registered together with the material negative established over the same bytes: book X has no lemma on Luke 24:12, its verse headings running 23:49, 23:50, 23:53, 23:55 and then jumping to 24:25, and the word-stems linteam-, sudari- and cucurr- do not occur in the book at all.
passages.notes: The parenthetical reference (Joan. XX, 8) inside the second sentence is Migne's apparatus and is omitted. The stem counts are counts over a transcription, not over page images, and an editorial or transcription omission cannot be excluded; consuming publications state the negative with that limit.

work.author: Ambrose of Milan
work.description: Ambrose's exposition of Luke in ten books, from about 389. Book X covers the passion and resurrection. The book has no lemma on Luke 24:12 and never mentions the burial cloths at the empty tomb; it does treat the theft allegation, on the different ground of the Jews' own testimony, and it asserts at section 179 that Peter could not have doubted. A locus is book.section or the book number alone.
work.title: Expositio evangelii secundum Lucam
